# Traversal Constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TraversalConstraint`](gmeow-TraversalConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TraversalConstraint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Mobile form as data: a set of fragments, allowed-successor links ([`mayFollow`](../properties/gmeow-mayFollow.md)), selection rules, and termination rules interpreted by a solver. Graph reachability and termination are solver work; no DL chain axiom is ever asserted over [`mayFollow`](../properties/gmeow-mayFollow.md) (Principles 4, 12).
